item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. Happy weekend! It's Saturday, September 12. Time for the weather! It's Saturday, a whole day to do what you like. Here in Shanghai, the day will be lovely and sunny. The high will be 31 degrees, and the low will be 22 degrees. Muggy and hot, so keep that water bottle close. You probably won't need a raincoat today. There are 13 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? It's going to be hot. Drink lots of water and wear a hat! As for tomorrow, expect it to be mostly bright with the odd cloud, with a high of 32 degrees. Here's a question: if you could invent a new weather, what would it be like? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
